legalName: Request to Expunge a Collateral Action, I.C. 35-38-9-9.5
publicName: Clearing a related case, forfeiture or driving-privileges matter after your expungement
documentTitleFull: REQUEST TO EXPUNGE A COLLATERAL ACTION PURSUANT TO I.C. 35-38-9-9.5
documentTitleNote: Derived from the legalName recorded on the track. No statewide form title exists to copy, because no statewide form has been identified for this mechanism.
courtCaptionNote: Token pattern. The layout is the Indiana expungement-filing caption recorded verbatim in the compiled IN profile: "STATE OF INDIANA ____________ IN THE __________________ _________________ COURT COUNTY OF __________________ CAUSE NO. ____________________________________". That passage is from a Coalition for Court Access form for arrest/charge/juvenile-allegation expungement (Form ACR block, CCA-XP-0120-7002 / CCA-XP-0220-7007), NOT from a section 35-38-9-9.5 form. No court, county or cause number is prefilled. Accepted caption for a 9.5 request is an open release blocker.

rationale: The registry declares outputStrategy and outputStrategyDeclared 'custom_pleading' for this track, with compositionMode null and units[] empty.

The scope restriction is explicit: "Resolved to custom_pleading with a local-form override for the current build. Do not carry an official-form label forward unless the actual current statewide form for this mechanism is acquired and verified."
packetSet.components lists three components, all with outputStrategy custom_pleading and officialFormId null: a required primary filing, a required proposed order, and a required attachment.

No official form is named anywhere on the track, so no official-form dependency is drafted or blocked for the filing itself. Whether the Coalition for Court Access publishes one is an open release blocker.

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: After an original expungement order is issued, a person may request expungement of an action or proceeding, including an administrative proceeding, factually or legally related to the arrest, charge, allegation, conviction or adjudication. This expressly includes a seizure, a civil forfeiture and a petition for specialized driving privileges.
Recorded on the track as authority for this mechanism. The registry does not state what this section supplies beyond listing it; no gloss is invented here.

supportingAuthorityNotCited.why: Recorded on the track only as the terminology basis - in Indiana expungement means records are sealed or restricted, not destroyed. It is a packet instruction, not a ground for this request, so it is not placed in the pleading's statutory-basis block.

verificationStatute.description: The source review states only that the participant signs the request, and records notarization 'none'. It states no verification statute, no oath, and no officer who must take one. Left null and flagged rather than invented, following the ND config's handling of its missing verification statute. The compiled IN profile does carry an Indiana affirmation formula - "I AFFIRM, UNDER THE PENALTIES OF PERJURY, THAT THE FOREGOING REPRESENTATIONS ARE TRUE AND ACCURATE" - but that text is from a Coalition for Court Access conviction/arrest expungement form, not from any section 35-38-9-9.5 material, and is not carried across.

includeProposedOrderReason: packetSet.components[1] records a required proposed_order component (in_collateral_action-proposed-order-2) with outputStrategy custom_pleading. The order body states only the relief the statute authorises - expungement of the identified collateral action - and names no record custodian, because no source enumerates custodians for a section 9.5 order.
includeCertificateOfServiceReason: The registry states the court notifies the prosecuting attorney of that county, and adds "Confirm local practice before assuming the participant need not serve." Because whether the participant must serve is expressly unconfirmed, no certificate of service is drafted and no service is asserted. The compiled profile's Indiana service convention ("Petitioner has served a copy of this petition upon the Prosecuting Attorney in accordance with the Indiana Rules of Trial Procedure") is from a conviction-expungement form and is recorded as a conflict for counsel, not applied.
serviceNote: The court notifies the prosecuting attorney. Confirm local practice before assuming the participant need not serve.

counselFlags.statement: Whether the Coalition for Court Access publishes a statewide request form for section 35-38-9-9.5 is open. If it does, this route may move to official_pdf_fill without changing the track's legal identity. Until then the scope restriction governs: do not carry an official-form label forward unless the actual current statewide form for this mechanism is acquired and verified.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether a statewide CCA request form exists for section 35-38-9-9.5.

counselFlags.statement: The caption in this config is a token pattern taken from the Indiana expungement caption recorded in the compiled profile, which comes from a Coalition for Court Access form for a different mechanism. It is not a confirmed accepted caption for a section 9.5 request, and it is unresolved whether such a request filed under the collateral action's own cause number should carry an in-re expungement caption or the collateral action's existing caption.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: What caption and format circuit and superior court clerks accept for a section 35-38-9-9.5 request filed under a collateral action's cause number.

counselFlags.statement: The registry says the court notifies the prosecuting attorney of that county and adds "Confirm local practice before assuming the participant need not serve." The compiled profile records the Indiana convention for expungement petitions the other way round: "Petitioner has served a copy of this petition upon the Prosecuting Attorney in accordance with the Indiana Rules of Trial Procedure." This config therefore sets includeCertificateOfService=false and asserts no service at all.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether the participant must serve the prosecuting attorney with a section 9.5 request, or whether court notice alone suffices.

counselFlags.statement: No verification statute, oath or notarization is stated for this request; the registry records notarization 'none' and says only that the participant signs. verificationStatute.citation is null rather than invented, and the profile's penalties-of-perjury affirmation formula from the conviction-expungement forms is not carried across.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether a section 9.5 request must be verified, and in what words.

counselFlags.statement: A properly certified original expungement order is a prerequisite the participant obtains and attaches. It is a required-before-filing item, not a generation blocker. A request without one is expressly excluded by the track.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the packet blocks filing, not generation, on the certified order, and that LegalEase never obtains, receives or inspects it.

counselFlags.statement: The statement of how the collateral action relates to the expunged matter is participant-authored. The registry is explicit: "Participant-authored. LegalEase formats the participant's own facts and does not compose the argument." The pleading provides the container and never generates, expands or argues the relationship.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the allegations block is never populated from anything but the participant's own words.

counselFlags.statement: Whether the collateral action relates to the expunged matter is the court's finding. The track lists as both an exclusion and a self-help stop condition: "The court finds the collateral action does not relate to the expunged matter." No artifact asserts relatedness as established.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no output states or implies the court has found, or will find, the matters related.

counselFlags.statement: packetSet.components[2] (in_collateral_action-attachment-3) is marked required with outputStrategy 'custom_pleading', but the only attachment the track records is the certified copy of the original expungement order, which the participant obtains from the clerk. Nothing is drafted for it. The component's output strategy looks like a registry data defect.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether the attachment component is meant to be the certified order (participant-obtained, nothing drafted) or a drafted exhibit index that no source describes.

counselFlags.statement: Never say records are destroyed. In Indiana expungement means records are sealed or restricted under section 35-38-9-1(k); the Office of Judicial Administration states plainly that court records are not deleted or destroyed under I.C. 35-38-9.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That rendered output and participant copy never use destroyed, deleted, erased or wiped.

counselFlags.statement: Disclose that the expungement case file is public until the order is granted.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the disclosure appears in participant copy before filing.

counselFlags.statement: Fourteen self-help stop conditions are recorded on this track, including: the prosecutor objects or files a notice in opposition; a victim submits a statement in opposition; the court sets a hearing; convictions in more than one county with the 365-day window partly consumed; a conviction not yet eligible where the person wants to file now (the Chastain trap); a Sections 2 through 5 petition already filed; unclear classification between Sections 2, 3, 4 and 5, or classification turning on serious bodily injury; sex or violent offender or registration status; unpaid or disputed fines, fees, costs or restitution; pending charges anywhere or pretrial diversion; a commercial driver's licence and 49 C.F.R. 384.226; immigration, firearm, licensing or CDL consequences; wanting to attack the underlying conviction.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That each stop condition is wired to a handoff and none of them is treated as a fact the packet may assert.

counselFlags.statement: Court name, county, cause number, judge, prosecuting attorney and the prosecutor's position are left blank in every fixture and are never prefilled. The only sourced venue rule is the track's own: a circuit or superior court in the county where the collateral action occurred, filed under the collateral action's cause number where possible.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That court identity reaches the document only through the participant's screening answers and the certified order they obtain.

counselFlags.statement: The court notifies the prosecuting attorney and sets a hearing, or may grant without one where the record conclusively establishes entitlement. Both are court acts. No artifact asserts that a hearing was or was not set, or how the court ruled.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That hearing and outcome are never stated as facts, and that a set hearing triggers handoff.

counselFlags.statement: The track carries a product instruction: offer this as a free follow-on to every granted conviction expungement. That is a routing and pricing instruction, recorded here so it is not lost in the pleading layer.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That routing implements the free follow-on rather than charging for this request.

counselFlags.statement: All four official sources recorded on this track carry sha256 null, so staleness cannot be detected for I.C. 35-38-9, I.C. 34-28-5-15, the Coalition for Court Access forms index, or the Office of Judicial Administration expungement page.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Capture hashes for the four official sources before release.

counselFlags.statement: I.C. 35-38-9-0.5 is listed in the track's authority array with no description anywhere in the registry entry or the compiled profile. It is cited in the pleading's statutory basis because the track records it as authority, but what it supplies is not stated and is not invented here.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: What I.C. 35-38-9-0.5 contributes to a collateral-action request, and whether it belongs in the pleading's statutory basis at all.

counselFlags.statement: The compiled IN profile contains zero occurrences of "9-9.5" and does not describe this mechanism. Its only relevant text is the phrase "records of collateral actions that relate to the expunged convictions or that relate to the cause number of the expunged convictions" inside the section 35-38-9-6 and -7 order forms, which is the concept but not the procedure. The registry entry is the sole procedural source.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the IN profile is extended to carry this track, or that the registry is accepted as its sole source of record.

REQUEST TO EXPUNGE A COLLATERAL ACTION PURSUANT TO I.C. 35-38-9-9.5, from the legalName recorded on the track.

Container only. Four sourced slots, each filled from a screening answer and never composed: the county and date of the original expungement; the section it was granted under; the county, cause number and kind of the collateral action; and the participant's own statement of how the two are connected. The relationship statement is expressly participant-authored.
Two citations, both from the track authority list: I.C. 35-38-9-9.5 and I.C. 35-38-9-0.5. The second carries no description in any source; see counselFlag in-collateral-authority-0-5-unexplained.

That the court expunge the records of the collateral action identified in the request. Scope phrase tracks the statute's own description of what may be requested; no custodian direction is included, because no source enumerates custodians for a section 9.5 order.

Signature block only, with no oath, affirmation or penalty formula, because none is stated. verificationStatute.citation is null. Handled the way the ND config handles its missing verification statute.
The participant signs the request. Required before filing. No LegalEase signature block, and no signature is ever pre-rendered.

Required component in the packet set (in_collateral_action-proposed-order-2). Body states only the relief the statute authorises. No record custodian is named and no distribution list is included: the profile's custodian list belongs to section 35-38-9-6 and -7 conviction-expungement orders, not to a section 9.5 order.

componentInventory.reason: The court notifies the prosecuting attorney, and whether the participant must also serve is expressly unconfirmed ("Confirm local practice before assuming the participant need not serve"). Drafting a certificate would assert a service obligation and a completed service act that no source establishes.
Notice is the court's act on this track: the court notifies the prosecuting attorney of that county. Nothing is drafted for the participant to give notice with.
No affidavit is recorded anywhere on this track. Notarization is 'none' and no sworn statement is required by any source read.

Neither the registry entry nor the compiled profile records a cover sheet for this track. The profile does record Indiana Access to Court Records forms - a Notice of Exclusion of Confidential Information from Public Access and a Confidential Information Form XP - but only inside the arrest/charge/juvenile-allegation expungement material, and no source says they attach to a section 9.5 request. Drafting or requiring one would be invention; see the handoff's F-review pointers.

packetSet.components[2] is a required attachment. The attachment is the certified copy of the original expungement order, which the participant obtains from the clerk of the court that granted it. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect it and drafts nothing for it. The component's recorded outputStrategy 'custom_pleading' appears to be a registry data defect; see counselFlag in-collateral-attachment-component-mislabelled.
